Volunteer hours

Bring your TrackItForward hours over. When you finish your member profile, open Volunteer hours and enter your current TrackItForward balance as Total hours since July 1. An officer will confirm them. After that, keep logging new hours here on the new site.

Tip: copy the number from TrackItForward. Later logs can still use this form for new shifts (change the hours and we will keep the same season label).

🍀

The Craic Cup

Kind rivalry. Real bragging rights. All for the craic.
Play →

Who’s bringing the most energy this season? Show up, volunteer, and stack Clovers 🍀. They fuel your rank and unlock badges. RSVP to upcoming events right inside the Cup, and earn +25 🍀 for cheering on another IKC krewe. Season restarts every July 1 - good-natured competition only.

🏆 Leaderboard📅 Upcoming events🌱 → 👑 Ranks🎖️ Badges 🤝 Volunteer bonuses🔎 Find My Clovers

Raffles

Gift baskets & 50/50 for charity - create, plan, enter
Open →

Build gift-ready baskets from donated contents, track who is bringing what, and raise money for charity. Draws happen in person at events - tickets are tracked digitally; pay a volunteer at the table.

🎁 Gift baskets💚 Charity📋 Planning🎫 In-person draws

Share Your Media

Upload photos & videos for the public site - plus artwork, poems, stories, essays & recipes
Open →

Share your work with the whole Krewe. Upload an MP4 video or photos, add a piece of artwork, or publish a poem, short story, essay, or recipe. Artwork, poems, stories, and recipes go live right away. Photos and videos are submitted for officer review before they appear on the public site, and they need a signed Photo & Image Release (faces/likeness) in Parade Ready first.

🎬 Videos 📷 Gallery photos 🎨 Artwork ✊️ Poems 📖 Stories & essays 🍲 Recipes
